description: This file defines the PermissionService interface for managing permissions within the user management module of the application. It declares methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting permissions, as well as obtaining permissions by various criteria and associations with user groups.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of permissions by name (parameter not specified).

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Lists all permissions, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a permission by its unique identifier.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new permission or updates an existing one.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Gets permissions associated with a list of group IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Lists permissions based on specific criteria provided via PermissionCriteria.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a permission from a specific group.
